basic_info.description: * 2 bedroom 2.5 Bath Condo with open floor plan; excellent for entertaining * On site security * Big, open dining room and living room with a working fireplace* Wide open walls make this home perfect for art lovers * Two spacious master suites, one which features a bath with tub and separate shower* Built in 2006 to reflect timeless good tastes and contemporary finishes * Stacked Bosch washer & dryer in unit * Generous storage- both bedrooms have walk in closets * Wide plank Brazilian Cherry flooring* At 1985 square feet (per builder), this condo is larger than most single family homes* Outdoor space includes a landscaped center courtyard and attached deeded deck, in one of the sunniest parts of the city* HOA dues $697 * Community Room* Deeded 1 car secure parking with direct access to the elevator * Easy access to 101/280 & close to 22nd Street Cal Train * Eclectic Potrero Hill neighborhood with restaurants, parks, and a unique small town within a big city feelPlease visit: www.SierraHeightsSF.com
